# **Comprehensive Architectural, Operational, and Mathematical Specification of the Pramana Cosmology Suite**

This document presents a complete comparative analysis and formal theoretical specification of pramana-cosmology-suite.skill (Version 1\) and pramana-cosmology-suite-2.skill (Version 2). Version 2 represents a fully backward-compatible, forward-additive iteration of its predecessor. Every computational script, theoretical model, dataset reference, and statistical sampler present in Version 1 is retained without functional regression in Version 2\.  
The key architectural extension in Version 2 is the incorporation of weak gravitational lensing and cosmic shear observables, accompanied by necessary adjustments to the underlying linear and non-linear Boltzmann physics engine. This report details the full 30-file execution hierarchy, operational sequence, and working mathematical equations governing the suite.

## **1\. Architectural File Persistence and Structural Delta**

The baseline package pramana-cosmology-suite.skill contains 28 files. The updated package pramana-cosmology-suite-2.skill contains 30 files, adding two new components and refactoring two existing files while maintaining 100% feature persistence.

| File Identifier | Repository Path | Baseline (v1) Status | Upgraded (v2) Status | Primary Purpose & Structural Role |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| SKILL.md | Root | Present | Modified | Primary skill orchestration, routing, and module configuration. |
| model\_definitions.md | references/ | Present | Preserved | Core cosmological parameter schema, physical constants, and prior bounds. |
| statistical\_methods\_guide.md | references/ | Present | Preserved | Reference specification for likelihoods, samplers, and emulators. |
| act\_dr6\_format.md | references/ | Present | Preserved | Data schema for Atacama Cosmology Telescope DR6 CMB power spectra. |
| desi\_dr2\_bao\_format.md | references/ | Present | Preserved | Data schema for DESI DR2 Baryon Acoustic Oscillation measurements. |
| pantheon\_data\_format.md | references/ | Present | Preserved | Data schema for Pantheon+ Type Ia supernova luminosity catalogs. |
| jwst\_modules.md | references/ | Present | Preserved | Data schema for JWST high-redshift galaxy UV luminosity functions. |
| weak\_lensing\_format.md | references/ | Absent | Added | Schema definition for tomographic lensing bins, shear calibration, and photo\-![][image1] shifts. |
| \_\_init\_\_.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Python package initialization file. |
| data\_io.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Observational data parser, validator, and matrix format handler. |
| models.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Expansion history, dark energy parameterization, and distance expressions. |
| differentiable\_models.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Auto-differentiation wrapper (JAX) for gradient-based inference drivers. |
| camb\_theory.py | scripts/ | Present | Refactored | Boltzmann solver computing CMB spectra, background geometry, and ![][image2]. |
| cmb\_act.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Likelihood evaluator for high\-![][image3] CMB temperature/polarization anisotropies. |
| bao\_desi.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Likelihood evaluator for DESI DR2 BAO distance-redshift ratios. |
| likelihood.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Likelihood evaluator for Type Ia supernova magnitude distance moduli. |
| jwst\_probes.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Likelihood evaluator for high\-![][image1] UV luminosity functions and halo mass bounds. |
| weak\_lensing.py | scripts/ | Absent | Added | Likelihood evaluator for cosmic shear cross-power spectra and intrinsic alignment. |
| data\_compression.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | MOPED and score vector compression algorithms for high-dimensional data. |
| joint\_likelihood.py | scripts/ | Present | Modified | Aggregator combining active probe log-likelihood terms into a unified score. |

| hmc\_numpyro.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Gradient-based Hamiltonian Monte Carlo / NUTS sampler driver. |
| nested\_sampling.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | PolyChord/Dynesty nested sampling engine for Bayesian evidence evaluation. |
| sbi\_inference.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Simulation-Based Inference driver using Neural Posterior Estimation (NPE). |
| diagnostics.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Chain convergence monitor computing Gelman-Rubin ![][image4] and effective sample sizes. |
| profile\_likelihood.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Optimizer evaluating frequentist profile likelihood ratios to check prior effects. |
| importance\_resampling.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Importance re-weighting engine for updating posteriors under new priors/datasets. |
| fisher\_forecast.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Fisher information matrix engine for forecasting parameter constraints. |
| plotting.py | scripts/ | Present | Preserved | Visualization utility generating posterior corner plots, residuals, and spectra. |

## **2\. Sequential Execution Workflow**

The operational flow across the 30 files in Version 2 follows a strict seven-phase execution pipeline:

* **Phase 1: Entry Point (SKILL.md)**  
  Ingests user configurations, resolves dependencies, and defines execution pipelines.  
* **Phase 2: Reference Validation (references/\*)**  
  Validates input parameter specifications, prior boundaries, and observational dataset formats against standardized schemas.  
* **Phase 3: Forward Physics Pipeline (scripts/data\_io.py ![][image5] scripts/models.py ![][image5] scripts/differentiable\_models.py ![][image5] scripts/camb\_theory.py)**  
  Loads observation vectors, constructs background trajectories, and executes CAMB to output linear and non-linear matter power spectra ![][image2] and angular CMB multipoles ![][image6].  
* **Phase 4: Probe Likelihood Computation (scripts/cmb\_act.py, scripts/bao\_desi.py, scripts/likelihood.py, scripts/jwst\_probes.py, scripts/weak\_lensing.py)**  
  Evaluates probe-specific chi-squared values and log-likelihoods.  
* **Phase 5: Aggregation and Data Compression (scripts/data\_compression.py ![][image5] scripts/joint\_likelihood.py)**  
  Compresses high-dimensional data vectors when requested and sums active log-likelihood terms into ![][image7].  
* **Phase 6: Posterior Exploration (scripts/gp\_emulator.py ![][image5] scripts/run\_mcmc.py / scripts/hmc\_numpyro.py / scripts/nested\_sampling.py / scripts/sbi\_inference.py)**  
  Explores the parameter space using selected stochastic, gradient-based, nested, or neural samplers, using Gaussian Process surrogates when enabled.  
* **Phase 7: Validation, Diagnostics, and Visualization (scripts/diagnostics.py, scripts/profile\_likelihood.py, scripts/importance\_resampling.py, scripts/fisher\_forecast.py, scripts/plotting.py)**  
  Performs convergence testing (![][image4]), profile likelihood ratio tests, importance resampling, Fisher matrix projection, and posterior plotting.

* **Purpose:** Models dynamic dark energy where ![][image15], allowing parameter estimation of dark energy time variations.

![][image16]

* **Purpose:** Computes spatial comoving distance to an object at redshift ![][image1].

![][image17]

* **Purpose:** Adjusts comoving distance for non-zero spatial curvature.

* **Purpose:** Models initial scalar fluctuations produced during inflation using amplitude ![][image22], tilt ![][image23], and running ![][image24] at pivot scale ![][image25].

#### **CMB Angular Power Spectra**

![][image26]

* **Purpose:** Computes theoretical multipole spectra ![][image6] (![][image27]) by integrating primordial power with Boltzmann radiation transfer functions ![][image28].

* **Purpose:** Evaluates angular shear cross-power spectra between tomographic bins ![][image30] and ![][image31] via the Limber approximation over non-linear matter power spectrum ![][image2].

#### **Lensing Efficiency Kernel**

![][image32]

* **Purpose:** Calculates the geometric efficiency of foreground matter at comoving distance ![][image33] in lensing background galaxies distributed as ![][image34].

* **Purpose:** Predicts galaxy number density ![][image55] as a function of absolute UV magnitude ![][image56], characteristic magnitude ![][image57], faint-end slope ![][image58], and normalization ![][image59].

### **3.7 Likelihood Evaluation, Vector-Jacobian Products & Data Compression**

Implemented in scripts/joint\_likelihood.py, scripts/differentiable\_models.py, and scripts/data\_compression.py.

#### **Gaussian Log-Likelihood**

![][image62]

* **Purpose:** Evaluates goodness-of-fit between data vector ![][image63] and theoretical prediction ![][image64] under covariance ![][image65].

#### **Multi-Probe Joint Likelihood Aggregation**

![][image66]

![][image67]

* **Purpose:** Evaluates exact likelihood gradients ![][image68] in JAX without finite-difference approximations for gradient-based samplers.

![][image69]  
![][image70]

![][image71]  
![][image72]

#### **Bayesian Model Evidence (Nested Sampling)**

![][image73]

* **Purpose:** Computes total marginal likelihood ![][image74] across prior volume ![][image75] for model selection.

#### **Neural Posterior Estimation Loss (SBI)**

* **Purpose:** Trains normalizing flow density estimators ![][image77] for likelihood-free inference.

### **3.9 Machine Learning Emulation, Diagnostics & Forecasting**

Implemented in scripts/gp\_emulator.py, scripts/diagnostics.py, scripts/profile\_likelihood.py, scripts/importance\_resampling.py, scripts/fisher\_forecast.py, and scripts/plotting.py.

#### **Gaussian Process Predictive Mean & Matérn 5/2 Kernel**

![][image78]  
![][image79]

* **Purpose:** Interpolates Boltzmann solver outputs to accelerate likelihood evaluations during MCMC sampling.

#### **Gelman-Rubin Convergence Diagnostic (![][image4])**

![][image80]

* **Purpose:** Tests MCMC chain convergence by comparing variance between chains (![][image81]) and variance within chains (![][image82]).

#### **Integrated Autocorrelation Time & Effective Sample Size**

![][image83]

* **Purpose:** Measures sample independence and autocorrelation lag across MCMC chains to evaluate true sample efficiency.

#### **Profile Likelihood Ratio**

![][image84]

* **Purpose:** Constructs frequentist confidence limits for parameter ![][image85] to check for Bayesian prior volume effects.

#### **Importance Resampling Weights**

![][image86]

* **Purpose:** Re-weights existing posterior samples under updated priors or secondary datasets without re-running full MCMC sampling.

#### **Fisher Information Matrix**

![][image87]

* **Purpose:** Forecasts parameter covariance bounds ![][image88] for survey design.

#### **Residual Vectors & Reduced Chi-Squared**

![][image89]

* **Purpose:** Computes normalized residual distributions and reduced goodness-of-fit indicators for observational model validation.

## **4\. Operational Summary**

The pramana-cosmology-suite-2.skill package is a complete, non-destructive upgrade over pramana-cosmology-suite.skill. All baseline functionality is preserved, while new features—specifically weak lensing shear spectra, ![][image35] structure growth constraints, intrinsic alignment modeling, non-linear matter power spectrum calculations, and enhanced nuisance calibration—are added. The suite integrates observational likelihood engines, Boltzmann calculations, data compression tools, auto-differentiation backends, and diverse sampling algorithms into a unified computational framework.
